Masking objects macro

Macros ›› Different types of macros ››

This macro is created via icon of the displays expandable toolbar (fourth from the bottom).

It's purpose is to move automatically a linked point of the figure.

It's purpose is to make hidden masked objects.

Clicking on the macro button will make these objects become invisible. First activate tool (macro execution on the top toolbar).


Two possibilities :

  • If radio button Click for next object is selected, you must click as many times as the macro manages objects.
  • If radio button Click for next object is not selected, a single click all the objects appear.
